parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A single property filter, or a combinator ("and" / "or") with a filters array. See Filtering.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordered list of sorts. Each entry has property and direction (ascending or descending). Earlier entries take precedence.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of meeting notes to return. Integer from 1 to 50. If omitted, the server uses 50.
